title: fix(metadata-protocol, rest)!: the layered read of a name two packages hold refuses as the plain read does, naming the holders as details.candidates (ADR-0150 D3/D5)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbNTugWasvhTMrtCZiFGrZYK)_

Fixes #32622
Fixes #32914

Clause-②: no (narrowing) — narrowed: a layered read naming no package, of a name two or more served packages register in code, no longer serves the holder that registered first. The REST `/layers` door on a host that wires no engine for its door chain goes from 200 to 409 naming the holders, and the in-process `getMetaItemLayered` goes from resolving to throwing `PackageScopedNameRefusedError`. The REST `/published` door on a host with no `objectQLProvider` goes from its published exit (the metadata service's `getPublished` answer, or 501 when the host resolves none) to 409 without `details.candidates`; the dispatcher's `/published` does not move. A name one package holds, and every read naming the package, answer as before.
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no skill under `skills/` names the layered or published door, and the docs that do (`content/docs/ui/apps.mdx`, `content/docs/references/api/rest-server.mdx`, `content/docs/concepts/metadata-lifecycle.mdx`, `content/docs/plugins/adding-a-metadata-type.mdx`) name the routes without teaching how a name two packages hold is answered there, so no sentence there turns false; the generated `content/docs/references/api/protocol.mdx` describes `packageId` as scoping a same-name collision, which still holds.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：按名字读元数据的分层视图（`GET /meta/TYPE/NAME/layers`，以及进程内的 `getMetaItemLayered`），遇到两个包都持有同名项、又没指定包时，现在和普通读一样答 409，并在 `details.candidates` 里列出两个包；以前 REST 在某些部署形态下、以及进程内调用，会悄悄返回先注册的那个包。
- 为什么改：同一个名字，普通读答 409 点名两包，分层读却按注册顺序挑一个（或只给一句话不给结构化候选），调用方无法知道该选哪个包，违反 ADR-0150 D3/D5“歧义要报告、不许猜、要列候选”。
- 风险与回滚：这是收窄（BREAKING）：没给 door chain 接引擎的部署上，两包同名、不指定包的 `/layers` 由 200（先注册包的分层）变为 409；进程内 `getMetaItemLayered` 由返回先注册包变为抛 `PackageScopedNameRefusedError`，调用方需改为指定包。只影响“两个包同名且没指定包”的分层读；单一持有者、带 `?package=` 的读、存储行持有者在禁用包旁的进程内读都不变；第一方触达 0。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-meta-layered-reads.ts`（`getMetaItemLayered` 新增的 `resolveItem` 判定，和 `withPackageCandidates`）；`packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-routes.ts`（`/layers` 路由 catch 加 `packageScopedCandidates`）；`packages/rest/src/meta-layers-ambiguous-package.test.ts` 新增的 describe。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/meta-layers-ambiguous-package.test.ts`，预期 12 个用例全绿（两包同名的 `/layers` 两种写法答 409 带 `details.candidates`，进程内读抛同样的拒绝，单持有者照常返回）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

**BREAKING** (`Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, patch level, `Metadata-protocol: none`): three answers move, the three bold rows of the table below. FROM 200 with the first-registered holder's layers TO 409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT` with `details.candidates`, on REST `/layers` where no engine is wired for the door chain; FROM resolving the first-registered holder TO throwing `PackageScopedNameRefusedError`, in process; FROM the published exit TO 409 without `details.candidates`, on REST `/published` where no `objectQLProvider` is wired (review-b F1, measured below). The fix for a caller: name the package. The changeset carries the banner and `adr-0087: not-required (no-migration-prescription)`: no key, stored row, layer or export changes shape.

Measured first on `main` `a557fa38` (real `RestServer`, real protocol, real `SchemaRegistry`; two packages registering the dashboard `sales`, no stored row):

| door | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| plain `GET /meta/dashboard/sales` | 409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT` with `details.candidates` | unchanged |
| REST `/layers`, engine wired for the door chain | 409, sentence only (no `details`) | 409 with `details.candidates` |
| REST `/layers`, no engine wired (no service copy, or a service copy of one holder) | **200, the first-registered holder's layers** | 409 with `details.candidates` |
| in process `getMetaItemLayered({ type, name })` | **resolves, the first-registered holder's layers** | throws `PackageScopedNameRefusedError` (409, `refusal.candidates` naming both) |
| REST `/published`, no `objectQLProvider` | **the published exit: the metadata service's `getPublished` answer, or 501 `NOT_IMPLEMENTED` when the host resolves no metadata service** | 409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, no `details` |
| REST `/published`, engine wired | 409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, no `details` | unchanged |
| dispatcher `/published`, the same composition | the snapshot (the throw is swallowed) | unchanged (not pinned; follow-up card) |
| `?package=` of either holder, and a name one package holds | served | unchanged |

- **`getMetaItemLayered` (#32914, and the REST pick folded into #32622 from #32624).** Naming no package, a type addressed by package is judged by the registry's package-scoped resolver (`registry.resolveItem(type, name, null, member)`), as `getMetaItem` judges it (`packagelessScopedRead`), before any layer is read and whatever the metadata service holds. Only the judgment is taken; a name one holder holds keeps the layers it had. Stored-row holders are not this judgment's: the door refuses them in step 1c, as contract review S1 on #33130 settled, and the in-process read in that state still resolves (the `[#32354]` pin is unchanged and green).
- **REST `/layers` catch (#32622).** `handleRouteError(res, error, undefined, { packageScopedCandidates: true })`, as the plain read's catch (#32201). The deprecated `?layers=true` spelling already answered through that catch. The dispatcher already carried the candidates (`errorFromThrown`).
- **Step 1c's refusal (#32622).** The package-less writes' refusal the layered door answers for a name whose active rows two packages hold (#28337) keeps its sentence, code, status and `?package=` remedy, and now carries its holders as a package-scoped refusal by shape (`refusal.status: 'refused'`, `candidates` in the `/actions` shape), so both transports answer `details.candidates`. The save and delete doors do not move. This is the item the #32607 seat re-ruling left to this card ("Carrying `details.candidates` on `/layers` remains #32622's job", 6820653691).
- `protocol.ts`: docblock only (9 lines, under the seat's 14:45Z rule change). `packagelessLayeredReadRefusal`'s docblock now says the refusal carries its holders as `refusal.candidates`, and that `getMetaItemLayered`'s in-process readers meet the registry's refusal of a name two packages register in code. The emitted `dist/index.js` and `dist/index.cjs` differ from `HEAD~1`'s in those comment lines alone (two builds, raw diff). A later commit adds the `@throws` for the two-holder refusal to `getMetaItemLayered`'s docblock (review-b N2, 4 lines).

## Tests

- `packages/rest/src/meta-layers-ambiguous-package.test.ts`, new describe `[#32622, #32914] a name two packages register, read naming no package`: 3 compositions (engine wired; no engine wired; no engine wired with a metadata-service copy of the first holder) x 2 registration orders, both spellings answer 409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT` with both holders as `details.candidates` and serve neither holder; in process the layered read refuses (`code` + `status` + `refusal.candidates`) in every composition and each `packageId` read still serves its holder; CONTROL: a name one package registers is served in process and on both spellings, and `?package=` serves its holder.
- `[#28337]` pins on both transports (`rest/.../meta-layers-ambiguous-package.test.ts`, `runtime/.../meta-layers-ambiguous-package.test.ts`, RestServer and hono): the envelope is now the writes' envelope plus `details`, with both holders as `details.candidates`; the writes' answer is asserted to carry no `details`.
- `[#32354]` ruling-Q2 pins (`rest/.../meta-disabled-package-doors.test.ts`, `runtime/.../meta-disabled-holder-served-stack.test.ts`): `/layers` now asserts `details.candidates` naming only the served holders.
- `metadata-protocol/.../protocol.packageless-layered-read-refusal.test.ts`: the step-1c refusal carries `refusal.candidates`; the save's refusal carries none.

<details><summary>Ablations (each leg restored; blob == HEAD proven by ablation-replace)</summary>

HEAD `6e50dbd5c7`. Baseline green: rest 62/62, metadata-protocol 3/3, runtime 367/367 (the three files above per package).

- **A2, the `/layers` catch without `packageScopedCandidates`** (rest source, read from `src`): 9 red, e.g. `/layers: expected [] to deeply equal [ 'package:app.alpha_demo', …(1) ]` and the ruling-Q2 pin `expected [] to deeply equal [ Array(2) ]`; the in-process and CONTROL cases stay green, as expected.
- **A1, `getMetaItemLayered` without the resolver judgment** (metadata-protocol rebuilt, marker `ABLATED_32914` present in 2 built files): 6 red, the no-engine cases `/layers: … "label":"app.alpha_demo code" …: expected [ 200, … ] to deeply equal [ 409, 'RESOURCE_CONFLICT' ]` and the in-process cases `expected [ undefined, undefined ] to deeply equal [ 'RESOURCE_CONFLICT', 409 ]`; the engine-wired cases stay green (the door's owner step refuses there), as expected.
- **A3, step 1c's refusal without its candidates** (metadata-protocol rebuilt, marker `ABLATED_32622` present): metadata-protocol `expected undefined to be 'refused'`; rest `expected [ 'code', 'error' ] to deeply equal [ 'code', 'details', 'error' ]`; runtime RestServer and hono twins red the same way (hono: `[ 'code', 'httpStatus', 'message' ]`). A first A3 attempt was refused by `ablation-replace` (its replacement contained the anchor, so the anchor count did not drop) and restored at once; its green readings were a no-op and are discarded.
- Restore leg: metadata-protocol rebuilt, both markers absent from all 24 built files, working tree clean.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- review-b F1 (should-fix) is closed on the prose faces here: the `/published` row is in the changeset banner, the `Clause-②` line and the table. The rest of it goes to a follow-up card the seat files: pins on both transports' bare `/published` with no `objectQLProvider`, `details.candidates` on the REST 409, and a decision on the dispatcher twin's swallow. No pin, no candidates and no swallow change are made here.
- review-b N1 (`echoSecurityCatalogMutation` recovers only on an `undefined` address, so a package-unbound `permission` event on a two-holder name now warns where it used to skip) is a code change, so it is left for the follow-up. N3 (the pins compare candidates sorted) was accepted by the review. N2 is folded as a docblock `@throws`.
- Declaration re-read after the diff, on the area seat's order: the claim declared `Clause-②: no`; measured, two answers move (the bold rows above), so the PR body and the changeset now declare `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` with the BREAKING banner, the `!` title and the ADR-0087 marker, after the #33646 precedent. On the composition that wires the engine (the default `RestServer` host) the door already answered 409. No gate reads the claim comment's line (the queue and level gates read this body and the changesets), so the claim comments were not amended.
- The in-process readers already handle the refusal: the packaged-permission-set lock gate and the security catalog echo catch a 409 naming package candidates and read each holder at its package (ADR-0150 D4, #31698).
- `git merge-tree --write-tree --name-only` of this head against the open PRs sharing a file and `origin/main`: #33898 (`64c5d88452`, shares `protocol.ts` and `meta-qualified-item-read.test.ts`), #33889 (`bdb3a20a71`, shares `meta-disabled-holder-served-stack.test.ts`) and `origin/main` (`895783a1e8`) each exit 0, no conflicted path. #33898's `protocol.ts` hunks sit near lines 322 and 7089; the docblock here is near line 4205.

## Verification

<details><summary>REST /published FROM and TO (review-b F1), measured at e516f3534b</summary>

A throwaway probe beside the REST pins, not committed. It used the same real protocol and real `SchemaRegistry`, with two packages registering the dashboard `sales`, `GET /meta/dashboard/sales/published` naming no package, both registration orders. TO is the head as built. FROM is the head with `getMetaItemLayered`'s resolver call ablated (`ablation-replace` landed, the marker present in 2 built files, then restored: blob equal to HEAD, marker absent from all 24 built files).

| composition | FROM | TO |
|---|---|---|
| engine wired (`objectQLProvider`) | 409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, `details` null | 409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, `details` null |
| no `objectQLProvider`, no metadata service | 501 `NOT_IMPLEMENTED` ("Nothing is runtime-published for this item, and this kernel has no code/package store …") | 409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, `details` null |
| no `objectQLProvider`, the protocol's service holding a copy of the first holder (two shapes) | 501 `NOT_IMPLEMENTED` (the REST host resolves no metadata service of its own) | 409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, `details` null |

The FROM on a host whose REST metadata service has `getPublished` (the service's answer, served 200) was NOT MEASURED. The probe shape for it, which stubs the host's `resolveMetadataService`, never got the verify lock: four 540 s waits behind pid 16926, a `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood exec vitest run --maxWorkers=1` holding over 60 minutes.
